facts: Status: ACTIVE in environment OpenShift / Run:AI
Scheduler: Run:AI (Policy-based fractional GPU allocation and priorities.)
Cluster: OpenShift (Enterprise Kubernetes runtime for AI workloads.)
Signals: OTel (Tracing and metrics exported for platform visibility.)
Component Kube ingress: OpenShift route controller (Keeps API access and routing policy outside the serving pool.)
Component Run:AI policy: Fractional GPU and priority scheduling (Allocates GPU slices to workloads based on team quota, priority, and serving class.)
Component GPU slices: Elastic VRAM allocation boundaries (Separates experimentation capacity from high-priority production inference.)
Component vLLM serving: PagedAttention runtime pods (Serves model traffic through a scalable deployment with cache-aware scheduling.)
Component OTel pipeline: Prometheus metrics and trace spans (Provides saturation, queue, latency, and GPU utilization signals to platform teams.)
